question: Highlight termination for convenience.
answer: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon thirty days written notice.
context: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause at any time effective upon thirty days written notice.

question: Highlight non-compete restrictions.
answer: The consultant shall not compete with the company in the territory during the restricted period.
context: The consultant shall not compete with the company in the territory during the term and for twelve months thereafter.

question: Highlight indemnification obligations.
answer: The supplier shall indemnify and hold harmless the customer from third party claims.
context: The supplier shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the customer from third party claims arising from the services.

question: Highlight liability limitations.
answer: Neither party shall be liable for consequential damages and aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid.
context: Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages. Aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid during the preceding twelve months.

question: Highlight confidentiality obligations.
answer: Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party.
context: Each party shall keep confidential and protect all non-public information received in connection with this Agreement.

question: Highlight governing law terms.
answer: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
context: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

question: Highlight automatic renewal terms.
answer: The Agreement will automatically renew for successive one-year periods unless either party gives notice.
context: The Agreement will automatically renew for successive one-year periods unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal.

question: Highlight assignment restrictions.
answer: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.
context: Neither party may assign or transfer its rights or obligations without the prior written consent of the other party.

question: Highlight audit rights.
answer: The customer may audit the supplier records on reasonable notice.
context: The customer may, on reasonable notice, audit records reasonably necessary to verify compliance with this Agreement.

question: Highlight data security obligations.
answer: The provider shall maintain reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards.
context: The provider shall maintain reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect personal data.

question: Highlight insurance obligations.
answer: The supplier shall maintain commercially reasonable insurance coverage during the term.
context: The supplier shall maintain commercially reasonable insurance coverage with reputable insurers during the term of this Agreement.

question: Highlight arbitration provisions.
answer: Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall be resolved by confidential arbitration.
context: Any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be resolved by confidential binding arbitration.
